en:
The time limit's gonna expire soon...
Which means...

In their desperation, these degenerate males
will snap and go on a rampage!

It's my time to shine! I'll keep a close eye
on these degenerates!

<CLT=cltMIND>I feel like Tenko would be the one to go on a
rampage... Should I spend time with her?
Yes! Let's take 'em all on together!

<CLT=cltMIND>In the end, I spent time with Tenko trying
to stop her from rampaging...
<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko and I grew a little closer today.
